label: GFREAD IGES letters in a D-entry field

inputs.name: CMD.KEY
inputs.text:
KFREAD
IN.KEY
GFREAD 1
BADD.IGS
KFWRIT
OUT.KEY

expect.notes: Field 3 of the first D entry is XX: the internal (8I8,4I2) read has no error branch, so the Fortran runtime aborts: stderr "? FORTRAN Runtime Error:" / "? Illegal character in numeric input" / "? READ(UNIT=INTERNAL,...", exit code -1, no OUT.KEY, empty DEF_IGS.OUT left.
